{{Top|leg}}
'''White-blight''' was a disease that affected the [[tallgrain]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], caused by a [[Worm/Legends|worm]] infestation in the roots of the [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. It could wipe out a field within days if not treated.
